metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics workspace where Microsoft Sentinel is deployed

properties.displayName: Firewall Beaconing Detection - Regular Outbound Connections
properties.description: Detects internal hosts making very regular, high-frequency connections to the same external IP across multiple hours. Beacon score = connections / hourly buckets. Covers Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, and Zscaler. MITRE ATT&CK: T1071, T1571.
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP", "Reset-Both")
| where isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
| where isnotempty(SourceIP)
| summarize
    ConnectionCount  = count(),
    BytesSent        = sum(SentBytes),
    BytesReceived    = sum(ReceivedBytes),
    HourlyBuckets    = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)),
    Ports            = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SourceIP, DestinationIP, DeviceVendor
| where ConnectionCount > 20 and HourlyBuckets >= 3
| extend BeaconScore = round(toreal(ConnectionCount) / toreal(HourlyBuckets), 1)
| where BeaconScore > 5
| order by BeaconScore desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Internal host {{SourceIP}} made regular-interval connections to {{DestinationIP}} (beacon score: {{BeaconScore}}).

properties.displayName: Firewall Anomalous Outbound Data Volume - Exfiltration Risk
properties.description: Detects internal hosts sending more than 500 MB to external destinations in 24 hours via Fortinet, Palo Alto, or Zscaler. MITRE ATT&CK: T1048.
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP", "Reset-Both")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) == true
| where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
| summarize
    TotalBytesSent    = sum(SentBytes),
    TotalBytesRecv    = sum(ReceivedBytes),
    SessionCount      = count(),
    DestIPs           = make_set(DestinationIP, 20),
    DestPorts         = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    HourlyBuckets     = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)),
    DeviceVendors     = make_set(DeviceVendor)
  by SourceIP
| extend TotalMBSent = round(toreal(TotalBytesSent) / 1048576, 2)
| where TotalMBSent > 500
| order by TotalMBSent desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Data Exfiltration Risk - {{SourceIP}} sent {{TotalMBSent}} MB outbound
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Host {{SourceIP}} transmitted {{TotalMBSent}} MB to external destinations across {{SessionCount}} sessions. Possible data exfiltration activity.

properties.displayName: Firewall Traffic to Threat Intelligence Flagged IP
properties.description: Correlates allowed firewall traffic against active ThreatIntelligenceIndicator entries. Any allowed connection to a TI-flagged IP is a high-confidence IOC. MITRE ATT&CK: T1071, T1078.
properties.query:
let TI_IPs =
    ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where Active == true
    | where isnotempty(NetworkIP)
    | summarize ThreatTypes = make_set(ThreatType), ConfidenceScore = max(ConfidenceScore)
        by TI_IP = NetworkIP;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP", "Reset-Both")
| where isnotempty(DestinationIP) or isnotempty(SourceIP)
| extend CheckIP = iff(ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false, DestinationIP, SourceIP)
| join kind=inner TI_IPs on $left.CheckIP == $right.TI_IP
| summarize
    HitCount         = count(),
    InternalIPs      = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    DeviceVendors    = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated),
    ThreatTypes      = make_set(ThreatTypes),
    ConfidenceScore  = max(ConfidenceScore)
  by TI_IP
| order by HitCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: TI Match - Firewall Allowed Traffic to {{TI_IP}}
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: TI-flagged IP {{TI_IP}} (confidence: {{ConfidenceScore}}) was seen in {{HitCount}} allowed firewall events. Possible C2 communication or active IOC.

properties.displayName: Firewall Port Scan Detection - Vertical and Horizontal Sweeps
properties.description: Detects source IPs hitting >30 unique destination ports (vertical scan) or >50 unique destination IPs (horizontal scan) in 1 hour. Indicates reconnaissance. MITRE ATT&CK: T1046.
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| summarize
    UniqueDestPorts = dcount(DestinationPort),
    UniqueDestIPs   = dcount(DestinationIP),
    TotalAttempts   = count(),
    Actions         = make_set(DeviceAction, 5),
    Protocols       = make_set(Protocol, 5),
    FirstSeen       = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen        = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SourceIP, DeviceVendor
| where UniqueDestPorts > 30 or UniqueDestIPs > 50
| extend ScanType = case(
    UniqueDestPorts > 30 and UniqueDestIPs <= 10, "Vertical Scan (port sweep)",
    UniqueDestIPs   > 50 and UniqueDestPorts <= 5, "Horizontal Scan (host sweep)",
    "Combined Scan")
| order by UniqueDestPorts desc, UniqueDestIPs desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Source {{SourceIP}} targeted {{UniqueDestIPs}} IPs across {{UniqueDestPorts}} unique ports. Possible network reconnaissance activity.

properties.displayName: Firewall Allowed Traffic to High-Risk Country
properties.description: Detects allowed firewall traffic to/from APT-associated countries (CN, RU, KP, IR, SY, CU, BY, VE, AF, LY). MITRE ATT&CK: T1078.
properties.query:
let HighRiskCountries = dynamic([
    "China", "Russia", "North Korea", "Iran", "Syria",
    "Cuba", "Belarus", "Venezuela", "Afghanistan", "Libya"]);
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP", "Reset-Both")
| where isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
| extend DestCountry = tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(DestinationIP).country)
| where DestCountry in (HighRiskCountries)
| summarize
    ConnectionCount  = count(),
    BytesSent        = sum(SentBytes),
    InternalIPs      = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    ExternalIPs      = make_set(DestinationIP, 20),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated),
    RepresentativeIP = any(SourceIP)
  by DestCountry, DeviceVendor
| order by ConnectionCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{ConnectionCount}} allowed firewall connections to {{DestCountry}} detected. Review for C2 or data exfiltration.

properties.displayName: Lateral Movement - Internal Host Port Sweep on Admin/Pivot Ports
properties.description: Detects an internal host connecting to more than 5 distinct internal targets on SMB, RDP, WinRM, SSH, or database ports. MITRE ATT&CK: T1021, T1570.
properties.query:
let LateralPorts = dynamic([22, 23, 135, 139, 445, 3389, 5985, 5986, 1433, 3306, 5432]);
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks")
| where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) == true
| where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == true
| where DestinationPort in (LateralPorts)
| summarize
    UniqueTargets   = dcount(DestinationIP),
    UniquePorts     = dcount(DestinationPort),
    TotalAttempts   = count(),
    TargetIPs       = make_set(DestinationIP, 30),
    PortsUsed       = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    Actions         = make_set(DeviceAction, 5),
    FirstSeen       = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen        = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SourceIP, DeviceVendor
| where UniqueTargets > 5
| order by UniqueTargets desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Host {{SourceIP}} connected to {{UniqueTargets}} internal targets on {{UniquePorts}} admin/pivot ports. Possible lateral movement or reconnaissance.

properties.displayName: Fortinet IPS - High-Frequency Intrusion Prevention Alerts
properties.description: Surfaces Fortinet IPS/App Control signatures firing more than 10 times in 24 hours. Indicates active exploitation attempts or compromised hosts. MITRE ATT&CK: T1190, T1203.
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where DeviceEventClassID has_any ("IPS", "anomaly", "signature")
    or Activity has_any ("ips-packet", "app-ctrl", "anomaly")
| summarize
    HitCount         = count(),
    SourceIPs        = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    DestinationIPs   = make_set(DestinationIP, 20),
    ProtocolsUsed    = make_set(Protocol, 5),
    SeverityValues   = make_set(LogSeverity, 5),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated),
    RepresentativeIP = any(SourceIP)
  by Activity, DeviceEventClassID
| where HitCount > 10
| order by HitCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Fortinet IPS/App Control signature {{Activity}} triggered {{HitCount}} events. Review source IPs and affected destinations for active exploitation.

properties.displayName: Palo Alto Networks - Threat Log Events (Spyware, Wildfire, Vulnerability)
properties.description: Surfaces Palo Alto threat log entries (malware, spyware, wildfire, virus, vulnerability) firing more than 5 times. MITRE ATT&CK: T1190, T1071.
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceVendor == "Palo Alto Networks"
| where DeviceEventClassID has_any ("THREAT", "threat", "WILDFIRE-VIRUS", "SPYWARE", "VULNERABILITY")
    or Activity has_any ("threat", "wildfire", "spyware", "vulnerability", "virus")
| summarize
    HitCount         = count(),
    SourceIPs        = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    DestinationIPs   = make_set(DestinationIP, 20),
    DestinationURLs  = make_set(RequestURL, 10),
    SeverityValues   = make_set(LogSeverity, 5),
    Actions          = make_set(DeviceAction, 5),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated),
    RepresentativeIP = any(SourceIP)
  by Activity, DeviceEventClassID
| where HitCount > 5
| order by HitCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Palo Alto threat signature {{Activity}} (class: {{DeviceEventClassID}}) fired {{HitCount}} times. Review for active malware, spyware, or vulnerability exploitation.

properties.displayName: Firewall New First-Seen External IP Contacted
properties.description: Identifies external IPs with >5 connections in 24 hours that were not seen in the prior 7-day baseline. May indicate freshly activated C2 infrastructure. MITRE ATT&CK: T1071.
properties.query:
let HistoricalIPs =
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(7d) .. ago(1d))
    | where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
    | where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP")
    | where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
    | summarize by DestinationIP;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP")
| where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
| where isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| summarize
    ConnectionCount  = count(),
    SourceIPs        = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    BytesSent        = sum(SentBytes),
    Ports            = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    Protocols        = make_set(Protocol, 5),
    DeviceVendors    = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated)
  by DestinationIP
| where ConnectionCount > 5
| join kind=leftanti HistoricalIPs on DestinationIP
| order by ConnectionCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: External IP {{DestinationIP}} received {{ConnectionCount}} allowed firewall connections in the last 24 hours but was not seen in the prior 7-day baseline. Possible new attacker infrastructure.

properties.displayName: Correlation: Firewall Allowed Traffic + Azure AD Sign-In from Same IP
properties.description: Correlates firewall-allowed outbound traffic with Azure AD sign-in events sharing the same external IP. Multi-vector activity from a single IP amplifies the compromise signal. MITRE ATT&CK: T1078.
properties.query:
let FirewallExternalIPs =
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
    | where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
    | where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP")
    | where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
    | summarize
        FW_Connections = count(),
        FW_Sources     = make_set(SourceIP, 10),
        FW_BytesSent   = sum(SentBytes),
        FW_Vendors     = make_set(DeviceVendor)
      by ExternalIP = DestinationIP;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ResultType == 0
| where isnotempty(IPAddress)
| summarize
    AAD_SignInCount  = count(),
    AAD_Users        = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 20),
    AAD_AppNames     = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10),
    AAD_Countries    = make_set(Location, 5),
    AAD_RiskLevels   = make_set(RiskLevelDuringSignIn, 5)
  by IPAddress
| join kind=inner FirewallExternalIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.ExternalIP
| project
    IPAddress,
    AAD_SignInCount,
    AAD_Users,
    AAD_Countries,
    AAD_RiskLevels,
    FW_Connections,
    FW_Sources,
    FW_BytesSent,
    FW_Vendors
| order by FW_Connections desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Cross-Signal IP Match - {{IPAddress}} in Firewall + AAD Sign-In
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: IP {{IPAddress}} generated {{AAD_SignInCount}} AAD sign-ins and {{FW_Connections}} firewall sessions. Multi-vector activity from a single source is a strong compromise indicator.

properties.displayName: Correlation: Firewall Traffic + Active Security Alert - Shared IOC IP
properties.description: Identifies IPs in both active Sentinel alerts (7 days) and live allowed firewall traffic (24 hours). Confirms flagged IOC is still communicating through the perimeter. MITRE ATT&CK: T1078, T1071.
properties.query:
let AlertIPs =
    SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where AlertSeverity in ("High", "Medium")
    | mv-expand todynamic(Entities)
    | where Entities.Type == "ip"
    | extend AlertIP = tostring(Entities.Address)
    | where isnotempty(AlertIP)
    | summarize
        AlertCount    = count(),
        AlertNames    = make_set(AlertName, 10),
        Severities    = make_set(AlertSeverity, 3),
        Products      = make_set(ProductName, 5)
      by AlertIP;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) or isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| extend CheckIP = iff(ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false, DestinationIP, SourceIP)
| summarize
    FW_HitCount     = count(),
    FW_Actions      = make_set(DeviceAction, 5),
    FW_InternalIPs  = make_set(SourceIP, 10),
    FW_Vendors      = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    FW_FirstSeen    = min(TimeGenerated),
    FW_LastSeen     = max(TimeGenerated)
  by CheckIP
| join kind=inner AlertIPs on $left.CheckIP == $right.AlertIP
| project
    IOC_IP        = CheckIP,
    AlertCount,
    AlertNames,
    Severities,
    Products,
    FW_HitCount,
    FW_Actions,
    FW_InternalIPs,
    FW_Vendors,
    FW_FirstSeen,
    FW_LastSeen
| order by AlertCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Active IOC in Firewall Traffic - {{IOC_IP}} ({{AlertCount}} alerts)
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: IP {{IOC_IP}} is referenced in {{AlertCount}} Sentinel alerts and generated {{FW_HitCount}} live firewall events. Confirmed active IOC still communicating through the perimeter.

properties.displayName: Correlation: Firewall Traffic Matching Threat Intelligence Domain / URL
properties.description: Matches firewall/proxy destination hostnames against active TI domain indicators. TI-flagged domain accessed through the perimeter indicates active C2 or malware staging. MITRE ATT&CK: T1071.
properties.query:
let TI_Domains =
    ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where Active == true
    | where isnotempty(DomainName)
    | summarize
        TI_ThreatTypes = make_set(ThreatType),
        TI_Confidence  = max(ConfidenceScore)
      by DomainName;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where isnotempty(DestinationHostName) or isnotempty(RequestURL)
| extend MatchKey = coalesce(DestinationHostName, RequestURL)
| join kind=inner TI_Domains on $left.MatchKey == $right.DomainName
| summarize
    FW_HitCount    = count(),
    FW_Users       = make_set(SourceUserName, 10),
    FW_SourceIPs   = make_set(SourceIP, 10),
    FW_Actions     = make_set(DeviceAction, 5),
    FW_Vendors     = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    TI_ThreatTypes = make_set(TI_ThreatTypes),
    TI_Confidence  = max(TI_Confidence),
    FirstSeen      = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen       = max(TimeGenerated)
  by MatchKey
| order by FW_HitCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: TI Domain Match in Firewall - {{MatchKey}} ({{FW_HitCount}} hits)
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: TI-flagged domain {{MatchKey}} (confidence: {{TI_Confidence}}) was contacted through the firewall {{FW_HitCount}} times. Possible C2 or active malware communication.

properties.displayName: Palo Alto Networks - High-Volume Inter-Zone Policy Denies
properties.description: Detects Palo Alto inter-zone policy deny spikes (>50 denies per policy). May indicate zone bypass attempts or firewall rule probing. MITRE ATT&CK: T1562, T1046.
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceVendor == "Palo Alto Networks"
| where DeviceAction in ("deny", "drop", "reset-client", "reset-server", "reset-both",
                         "Reset-Both", "Drop", "Deny")
| where isnotempty(DeviceCustomString1) or isnotempty(DeviceCustomString2)
| summarize
    DenyCount        = count(),
    SourceIPs        = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    DestinationIPs   = make_set(DestinationIP, 20),
    Ports            = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    Protocols        = make_set(Protocol, 5),
    PolicyNames      = make_set(DeviceCustomString1, 10),
    SourceZones      = make_set(DeviceCustomString2, 5),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated),
    RepresentativeIP = any(SourceIP)
  by DeviceCustomString1, DeviceCustomString2, DeviceAction
| where DenyCount > 50
| order by DenyCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Palo Alto Policy Deny Spike - {{DeviceCustomString1}} ({{DenyCount}} denies)
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Palo Alto policy {{DeviceCustomString1}} generated {{DenyCount}} deny events. High deny volume may indicate zone bypass attempts or firewall rule testing.

properties.displayName: Fortinet SSL-VPN and Admin Authentication Brute Force
properties.description: Detects >5 Fortinet SSL-VPN or admin authentication failures from a single source. VPN brute force is a primary initial access vector. MITRE ATT&CK: T1110.
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where DeviceEventClassID has_any ("32001", "32002", "39424", "39952")
    or Activity has_any ("ssl-vpn-tunnel", "vpn", "admin-login", "loginfailed",
                         "login failure", "authentication failed")
    or DeviceAction has_any ("failed", "denied", "reject", "failure")
| summarize
    FailureCount     = count(),
    UniqueUsers      = dcount(SourceUserName),
    UserList         = make_set(SourceUserName, 20),
    DestinationIPs   = make_set(DestinationIP, 5),
    SourcePorts      = make_set(SourcePort, 5),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SourceIP, DeviceEventClassID
| where FailureCount > 5
| order by FailureCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Source {{SourceIP}} generated {{FailureCount}} Fortinet authentication failures targeting {{UniqueUsers}} unique accounts. Possible VPN credential brute force attack.

properties.displayName: Protocol Anomaly - HTTP or HTTPS on Non-Standard Ports
properties.description: Detects allowed HTTP/HTTPS traffic on non-standard ports. C2 frameworks use alternate ports to blend into web traffic while evading port-based rules. MITRE ATT&CK: T1571.
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP")
| where (ApplicationProtocol in ("HTTP", "http") and DestinationPort !in (80, 8080, 8000, 3128))
    or (ApplicationProtocol in ("HTTPS", "https", "SSL", "ssl") and DestinationPort !in (443, 8443))
    or (Protocol in ("HTTP", "http") and DestinationPort !in (80, 8080, 8000, 3128))
    or (Protocol in ("HTTPS", "https") and DestinationPort !in (443, 8443))
| summarize
    ConnectionCount  = count(),
    SourceIPs        = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    DestIPs          = make_set(DestinationIP, 20),
    BytesSent        = sum(SentBytes),
    URLSamples       = make_set(RequestURL, 10),
    DeviceVendors    = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated),
    RepresentativeIP = any(SourceIP)
  by DestinationPort, ApplicationProtocol, Protocol
| order by ConnectionCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{ConnectionCount}} allowed connections using {{ApplicationProtocol}} on non-standard port {{DestinationPort}}. Possible C2 channel disguised as web traffic.

properties.displayName: Anomalous User Firewall Activity - High Request Count or Data Volume
properties.description: Detects users generating more than 1,000 allowed firewall requests or sending more than 200 MB in 24 hours across Fortinet, Palo Alto, or Zscaler. Anomalously high per-user traffic is a strong insider threat or compromised account indicator. No UEBA connector required. MITRE ATT&CK: T1078.
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP")
| where isnotempty(SourceUserName)
| summarize
    FW_RequestCount  = count(),
    FW_BytesSent     = sum(SentBytes),
    FW_BytesRecv     = sum(ReceivedBytes),
    FW_DestIPs       = dcount(DestinationIP),
    FW_Vendors       = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    FW_SrcIPs        = make_set(SourceIP, 5),
    FW_FirstSeen     = min(TimeGenerated),
    FW_LastSeen      = max(TimeGenerated)
  by UserName = tolower(SourceUserName)
| extend TotalMBSent = round(toreal(FW_BytesSent) / 1048576, 2)
| where FW_RequestCount > 1000 or TotalMBSent > 200
| extend RiskScore = case(
    TotalMBSent > 1000, "Critical",
    TotalMBSent > 500 or FW_RequestCount > 5000, "High",
    TotalMBSent > 200 or FW_RequestCount > 1000, "Medium",
    "Low")
| project
    UserName,
    FW_RequestCount,
    TotalMBSent,
    FW_DestIPs,
    FW_Vendors,
    FW_SrcIPs,
    RiskScore
| order by TotalMBSent desc, FW_RequestCount desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: User {{UserName}} generated {{TotalMBSent}} MB and {{FW_RequestCount}} firewall requests in 24h. Possible data exfiltration or compromised account.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q01 - Beaconing Detection - All Vendors
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP", "Reset-Both")
| where isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
| where isnotempty(SourceIP)
| summarize
    ConnectionCount  = count(),
    BytesSent        = sum(SentBytes),
    BytesReceived    = sum(ReceivedBytes),
    HourlyBuckets    = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)),
    Ports            = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SourceIP, DestinationIP, DeviceVendor
| where ConnectionCount > 20 and HourlyBuckets >= 3
| extend BeaconScore = round(toreal(ConnectionCount) / toreal(HourlyBuckets), 1)
| where BeaconScore > 5
| order by BeaconScore desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Detects internal hosts making regular high-frequency connections to the same external IP across multiple hours. Beacon score = connections / hourly buckets.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q02 - Data Exfiltration - Anomalous Outbound Volume
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP", "Reset-Both")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) == true
| where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
| summarize
    TotalBytesSent    = sum(SentBytes),
    TotalBytesRecv    = sum(ReceivedBytes),
    SessionCount      = count(),
    DestIPs           = make_set(DestinationIP, 20),
    DestPorts         = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    HourlyBuckets     = dcount(bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)),
    DeviceVendors     = make_set(DeviceVendor)
  by SourceIP
| extend TotalMBSent = round(toreal(TotalBytesSent) / 1048576, 2)
| where TotalMBSent > 500
| order by TotalMBSent desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Detects internal hosts sending more than 500 MB to external destinations in 24 hours.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q03 - Threat Intelligence IP Correlation
properties.query:
let TI_IPs =
    ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where Active == true
    | where isnotempty(NetworkIP)
    | summarize ThreatTypes = make_set(ThreatType), ConfidenceScore = max(ConfidenceScore)
        by TI_IP = NetworkIP;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP", "Reset-Both")
| where isnotempty(DestinationIP) or isnotempty(SourceIP)
| extend CheckIP = iff(ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false, DestinationIP, SourceIP)
| join kind=inner TI_IPs on $left.CheckIP == $right.TI_IP
| summarize
    HitCount         = count(),
    InternalIPs      = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    DeviceVendors    = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated),
    ThreatTypes      = make_set(ThreatTypes),
    ConfidenceScore  = max(ConfidenceScore)
  by TI_IP
| order by HitCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Matches allowed firewall traffic source/dest IPs against active ThreatIntelligenceIndicator entries.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q04 - Port Scanning - Single Source to Many Destinations
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| summarize
    UniqueDestPorts = dcount(DestinationPort),
    UniqueDestIPs   = dcount(DestinationIP),
    TotalAttempts   = count(),
    Actions         = make_set(DeviceAction, 5),
    Protocols       = make_set(Protocol, 5),
    FirstSeen       = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen        = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SourceIP, DeviceVendor
| where UniqueDestPorts > 30 or UniqueDestIPs > 50
| extend ScanType = case(
    UniqueDestPorts > 30 and UniqueDestIPs <= 10, "Vertical Scan (port sweep, single host)",
    UniqueDestIPs   > 50 and UniqueDestPorts <= 5, "Horizontal Scan (host sweep, single port)",
    "Combined Scan")
| order by UniqueDestPorts desc, UniqueDestIPs desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Detects port sweep or host sweep: source IP hitting more than 30 unique dest ports or 50 unique dest IPs in 1 hour.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q05 - High-Risk Country Inbound and Outbound Traffic
properties.query:
let HighRiskCountries = dynamic([
    "China", "Russia", "North Korea", "Iran", "Syria",
    "Cuba", "Belarus", "Venezuela", "Afghanistan", "Libya"]);
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP", "Reset-Both")
| where isnotempty(DestinationIP) or isnotempty(SourceIP)
| extend
    DstCountry = tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(DestinationIP).country),
    SrcCountry = tostring(geo_info_from_ip_address(SourceIP).country)
| where DstCountry in (HighRiskCountries) or SrcCountry in (HighRiskCountries)
| summarize
    ConnectionCount  = count(),
    BytesSent        = sum(SentBytes),
    InternalIPs      = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    ExternalIPs      = make_set(DestinationIP, 20),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated)
  by DstCountry, SrcCountry, DeviceVendor
| order by ConnectionCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Detects allowed firewall traffic to/from APT-associated countries.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q06 - Lateral Movement - Internal Port Sweep
properties.query:
let LateralPorts = dynamic([22, 23, 135, 139, 445, 3389, 5985, 5986, 1433, 3306, 5432]);
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks")
| where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) == true
| where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == true
| where DestinationPort in (LateralPorts)
| summarize
    UniqueTargets   = dcount(DestinationIP),
    UniquePorts     = dcount(DestinationPort),
    TotalAttempts   = count(),
    TargetIPs       = make_set(DestinationIP, 30),
    PortsUsed       = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    Actions         = make_set(DeviceAction, 5),
    FirstSeen       = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen        = max(TimeGenerated)
  by SourceIP, DeviceVendor
| where UniqueTargets > 5
| order by UniqueTargets desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Detects an internal IP connecting to many internal hosts on SMB, RDP, WinRM, SSH, or database ports.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q12 - New and First-Seen External IP Allowed Through Firewall
properties.query:
let HistoricalIPs =
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(7d) .. ago(1d))
    | where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
    | where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP")
    | where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
    | summarize by DestinationIP;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP")
| where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
| where isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| summarize
    ConnectionCount  = count(),
    SourceIPs        = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    BytesSent        = sum(SentBytes),
    Ports            = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    Protocols        = make_set(Protocol, 5),
    DeviceVendors    = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated)
  by DestinationIP
| where ConnectionCount > 5
| join kind=leftanti HistoricalIPs on DestinationIP
| order by ConnectionCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Identifies external destination IPs not seen in the prior 7 days that appeared in the last 24 hours.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q13 - Firewall Allow plus Azure AD Sign-In Correlation
properties.query:
let FirewallExternalIPs =
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
    | where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
    | where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP")
    | where ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false
    | summarize
        FW_Connections = count(),
        FW_Sources     = make_set(SourceIP, 10),
        FW_BytesSent   = sum(SentBytes),
        FW_Vendors     = make_set(DeviceVendor)
      by ExternalIP = DestinationIP;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResultType == 0
| where isnotempty(IPAddress)
| summarize
    AAD_SignInCount  = count(),
    AAD_Users        = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 20),
    AAD_AppNames     = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10),
    AAD_Countries    = make_set(Location, 5),
    AAD_RiskLevels   = make_set(RiskLevelDuringSignIn, 5)
  by IPAddress
| join kind=inner FirewallExternalIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.ExternalIP
| project
    IPAddress,
    AAD_SignInCount,
    AAD_Users,
    AAD_Countries,
    AAD_RiskLevels,
    FW_Connections,
    FW_Sources,
    FW_BytesSent,
    FW_Vendors
| order by FW_Connections desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Correlates firewall-allowed external IPs against Azure AD successful sign-ins from the same IP.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q14 - CommonSecurityLog plus SecurityAlert IOC Correlation
properties.query:
let AlertIPs =
    SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where AlertSeverity in ("High", "Medium")
    | mv-expand todynamic(Entities)
    | where Entities.Type == "ip"
    | extend AlertIP = tostring(Entities.Address)
    | where isnotempty(AlertIP)
    | summarize
        AlertCount    = count(),
        AlertNames    = make_set(AlertName, 10),
        Severities    = make_set(AlertSeverity, 3),
        Products      = make_set(ProductName, 5)
      by AlertIP;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) or isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| extend CheckIP = iff(ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP) == false, DestinationIP, SourceIP)
| summarize
    FW_HitCount     = count(),
    FW_Actions      = make_set(DeviceAction, 5),
    FW_InternalIPs  = make_set(SourceIP, 10),
    FW_Vendors      = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    FW_FirstSeen    = min(TimeGenerated),
    FW_LastSeen     = max(TimeGenerated)
  by CheckIP
| join kind=inner AlertIPs on $left.CheckIP == $right.AlertIP
| project
    IOC_IP        = CheckIP,
    AlertCount,
    AlertNames,
    Severities,
    Products,
    FW_HitCount,
    FW_Actions,
    FW_InternalIPs,
    FW_Vendors,
    FW_FirstSeen,
    FW_LastSeen
| order by AlertCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Identifies firewall IPs that also appear in active Security Alerts from Defender or Sentinel.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q15 - CommonSecurityLog plus ThreatIntelligence Domain Match
properties.query:
let TI_Domains =
    ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where Active == true
    | where isnotempty(DomainName)
    | summarize
        TI_ThreatTypes = make_set(ThreatType),
        TI_Confidence  = max(ConfidenceScore)
      by DomainName;
let TI_URLs =
    ThreatIntelligenceIndicator
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where Active == true
    | where isnotempty(Url)
    | summarize
        TI_ThreatTypes = make_set(ThreatType),
        TI_Confidence  = max(ConfidenceScore)
      by Url;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where isnotempty(DestinationHostName) or isnotempty(RequestURL)
| extend MatchKey = coalesce(DestinationHostName, RequestURL)
| join kind=inner TI_Domains on $left.MatchKey == $right.DomainName
| summarize
    FW_HitCount    = count(),
    FW_Users       = make_set(SourceUserName, 10),
    FW_SourceIPs   = make_set(SourceIP, 10),
    FW_Actions     = make_set(DeviceAction, 5),
    FW_Vendors     = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    TI_ThreatTypes = make_set(TI_ThreatTypes),
    TI_Confidence  = max(TI_Confidence),
    FirstSeen      = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen       = max(TimeGenerated)
  by MatchKey
| order by FW_HitCount desc

tags.value: Joins firewall traffic against TI feed URLs and domains across all three vendors.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q16 - Palo Alto - Zone Transfer Violations and Policy Denies

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q17 - Fortinet - Repeated Auth Failures SSL-VPN and Admin
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where DeviceVendor == "Fortinet"
| where DeviceEventClassID has_any ("32001", "32002", "39424", "39952")

    or DeviceAction has_any ("failed", "denied", "reject", "failure")

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q19 - Protocol Anomaly - HTTP and HTTPS on Non-Standard Ports
properties.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP")
| where (ApplicationProtocol in ("HTTP", "http") and DestinationPort !in (80, 8080, 8000, 3128))
    or (ApplicationProtocol in ("HTTPS", "https", "SSL", "ssl") and DestinationPort !in (443, 8443))
    or (Protocol in ("HTTP", "http") and DestinationPort !in (80, 8080, 8000, 3128))
    or (Protocol in ("HTTPS", "https") and DestinationPort !in (443, 8443))
| summarize
    ConnectionCount  = count(),
    SourceIPs        = make_set(SourceIP, 20),
    DestIPs          = make_set(DestinationIP, 20),
    BytesSent        = sum(SentBytes),
    URLSamples       = make_set(RequestURL, 10),
    DeviceVendors    = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    FirstSeen        = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen         = max(TimeGenerated)
  by DestinationPort, ApplicationProtocol, Protocol
| order by ConnectionCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Detects HTTP/HTTPS running on non-standard ports, common in C2 malware evasion techniques.

properties.displayName: CSL Hunt Q20 - Firewall plus IdentityInfo Risky User Correlation
properties.query:
let RiskyIdentities =
    IdentityInfo
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | where isnotempty(AccountUPN)
    | summarize
        RiskScore        = max(InvestigationPriority),
        JobTitle         = any(JobTitle),
        Department       = any(Department),
        Manager          = any(Manager),
        IsAccountEnabled = any(IsAccountEnabled)
      by AccountUPN;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where DeviceVendor in ("Fortinet", "Palo Alto Networks", "Zscaler")
| where DeviceAction !in ("deny", "block", "drop", "BLOCK", "DROP")
| where isnotempty(SourceUserName)
| summarize
    FW_RequestCount  = count(),
    FW_BytesSent     = sum(SentBytes),
    FW_BytesRecv     = sum(ReceivedBytes),
    FW_DestIPs       = dcount(DestinationIP),
    FW_Vendors       = make_set(DeviceVendor),
    FW_SrcIPs        = make_set(SourceIP, 5),
    FW_FirstSeen     = min(TimeGenerated)
  by UserName = tolower(SourceUserName)
| join kind=inner RiskyIdentities on $left.UserName == $right.AccountUPN
| extend TotalMBSent = round(toreal(FW_BytesSent) / 1048576, 2)
| project
    UserName,
    JobTitle,
    Department,
    RiskScore,
    FW_RequestCount,
    TotalMBSent,
    FW_DestIPs,
    FW_Vendors,
    FW_SrcIPs
| order by RiskScore desc, TotalMBSent desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Matches firewall traffic source users against IdentityInfo to surface high-risk accounts.
